description: A long top-lit room, lots set out on trestles down both sides and the middle clear for trolleys. Every item has a paper tag on a string. At the far end, a plain rostrum three steps up with a gavel on the rail. The chairs in front of it are stacked.

window.description: A run of high glazing under the eaves, grey and even, lighting the lots from above the way a saleroom is supposed to be lit. You cannot see out of it and that is the point.
window.name: the clerestory

name: Halcyon Salerooms — The Saleroom
